questions.text:
Analyse how the setting helped you understand one or more characters.

"Setting" may refer to physical places as well as social and historical contexts.

Write an essay on at least ONE written text that you have studied, in response to this question. Support the points you make with specific details from the text(s). You should aim to write a concise essay of no more than 4-5 pages.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement (3-4): Present a structured response using essay conventions and analysis-related terminology appropriately. Address the question by exploring a relevant idea about how setting helps understand character(s), showing awareness that effects and meanings have been deliberately crafted. Include specific and relevant details from the text(s). Merit (5-6): Convincingly address the question, presenting a reasoned discussion of one or more ideas showing clear understanding. Show awareness that effects and meanings have been deliberately crafted for a particular purpose. Weave a range of specific details from the text(s) to support the main idea(s). Excellence (7-8): Develop an insightful or original argument supported by reasoned interpretation. Make judgments about the ways that effects and meanings relate to the purpose of the text(s). Weave a range of specific and relevant details to support the argument or interpretation.
